chunks: But he beguiled a great many of you. Why did you not then understand?
ai.seo_question: Who misled a great many of humanity according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the collective failure of humanity to utilize their God-given intellect ('aql) to recognize the truth, emphasizing that misguidance is often a result of neglecting reason rather than divine decree. It serves as a poignant reminder that the 'large portion' misled includes those who claim faith but fail to apply rational reflection to their spiritual state.
